note: INT-1 (ADR-0096 D2/D5 golden routing ratchet). Scored end-to-end by apps/quoky/src/personal-v2-acceptance.test.ts against the production AppModule: `route` is the registered handler id that claimed the turn, `runtime` (a deterministic runtime branch: help, post-push replies) or `classifier` (fell through to intent classification/chat). `kind` is the work-chat command kind; `reply` labels a runtime reply; `providerCalls: 0` pins a deterministic turn. `ctx.openTodos` are added through the to-do handler first; `ctx.applyAnchor` seeds a post-push apply-preview anchor.
